datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule (January and February 2022 shown) across Yemen administrative units. The data represents spatial projections of acute food insecurity phases, which are indirect impacts of underlying hazards (primarily drought and conflict-related disruptions). Classifications were standardized using the IPC scale and georeferenced to administrative boundaries.
